title.zh: 刺络拔罐与经筋刺法：刺血加闪火罐“血尽邪出”并以血色与出血量为度；经筋刺法以排刺、透刺、围刺疏理经筋，起点是周围性面瘫
title.en: Pricking-Cupping and Jingjin Needling: Bloodletting Plus Flash-fire Cupping to "Exhaust Blood and Evil", Judged by Blood Colour and Volume; Jingjin Needling with Row, Through and Encircling Needles to Free the Sinews, Starting from Peripheral Facial Palsy

summary.zh: 这是他的两项自创刺法。刺络拔罐把三棱针点刺与闪火罐合用：单纯刺络血液自然流出，“瘀血留注不消，贼邪伏而不退”，加罐后可“血尽邪出，且可控制出血量”，并以血色由黑转红为度；处方里出血量因部位而异(背颈肩与哮喘、带状疱疹多为5~10ml，面部与腰腿多为3~5ml，湿疹痤疮2~3ml)，留罐多不超过5分钟。经筋刺法以“病本在经脉，病标在经筋”解面瘫，用排刺、一针多向透刺综合分刺、恢刺、合谷刺，主穴阳白四透、太阳透地仓、地仓颊车间排刺；后来在处方里也用于吞咽困难和皮损围刺。
summary.en: Two of his own techniques. Pricking-cupping joins three-edged-needle pricking with flash-fire cupping: with pricking alone blood flows out by itself, "stagnant blood stays and evil lurks"; a cup gives "blood exhausted, evil out, and controllable volume", judged by the blood turning from black to red. Volumes in the entries vary by site (5-10 ml for back, neck, shoulder, asthma and zoster; 3-5 ml for face and waist-leg; 2-3 ml for eczema and acne), retention mostly within 5 minutes. Jingjin needling explains facial palsy as "root in the channel, branch in the sinew", using row needling and multi-direction through-needling that combine the Neijing fen, hui and hegu needling, main points Yangbai four-way, Taiyang to Dicang, row needling from Dicang to Jiache; later entries also use it for dysphagia and for encircling skin lesions.

takeaways.zh: 刺络拔罐是“刺血术与拔罐法相结合的独特针刺方法”，设计的理由是补刺血的不足：单纯刺络让血自然流出或稍加挤压，“往往瘀血留注不消，贼邪伏而不退”；点刺后加闪火罐，罐内负压“可达血尽邪出，且可控制出血量”。工具是三棱针或七星针、梅花针，前提是“辨证选取穴区”。
takeaways.en: Pricking-cupping is "a distinctive method combining bloodletting and cupping", designed to make up for what bloodletting alone lacks: with pricking alone blood flows out by itself or with light squeezing, "stagnant blood often stays and evil lurks"; adding a flash-fire cup, the negative pressure gives "blood exhausted, evil out, and controllable volume". Tools are the three-edged, seven-star or plum-blossom needle, on the premise of "selecting the area by syndrome differentiation".

takeaways.zh: 出血量是关键，判据是血色：“出血颜色的变化”，血射出而黑，必会变赤，“见赤为止”，否则“病必不除而反为害”；用玻璃罐可以直接观察，“达到预定标准，即行起罐”。这是他把加罐的好处落到操作上的地方。
takeaways.en: Volume is the key and blood colour is the criterion: black blood turns red as it clears, "stop when it is red", otherwise "the disease will not go and harm results"; a glass cup allows direct watching and the cup is removed "once the set standard is reached". This is where the benefit of adding a cup is made operational.

takeaways.zh: 处方里把血色标准换算成毫升数，并随部位和病情增减：出血量5~10ml的有19条(咳嗽、哮喘发作期、落枕、脊柱炎、臂丛神经痛、肩周炎、肘劳、带状疱疹、急性鼻炎、中风)，3~5ml有15条(面瘫、三叉神经痛、腰痛、坐骨神经痛、类风湿关节炎、呃逆、淋巴管炎)，2~3ml有3条(湿疹、痤疮)，扁桃体、喉喑点刺少商等只出1~2滴。哮喘一条明说：“哮喘严重时出血量可以稍多一些，缓解期出血量为3~5ml”。每次点刺3~5点、留罐多不超过5分钟(带状疱疹8分钟，腰痛、三叉神经痛、坐骨神经痛可到5~10分钟)。
takeaways.en: The entries convert the colour rule into millilitres and adjust for site and severity. Volume 5-10 ml in 19 entries (cough, asthma attack, stiff neck, spondylosis, brachial plexus pain, shoulder periarthritis, tennis elbow, herpes zoster, acute rhinitis, stroke); 3-5 ml in 15 (facial palsy, trigeminal neuralgia, low-back pain, sciatica, rheumatoid arthritis, hiccup, lymphangitis); 2-3 ml in 3 (eczema, acne); tonsillitis and hoarseness prick Shaoshang and the like for only 1-2 drops. The asthma entry says so outright: "in severe asthma the volume may be somewhat larger, in remission 3-5 ml". Each session pricks 3-5 points, retention mostly under 5 minutes (8 for zoster; 5-10 for waist, trigeminal and sciatic pain).

takeaways.zh: 他给刺络拔罐列了六种作用：活血通络“是刺络拔罐最主要、最直接的作用”；还有祛瘀生新、温经散寒、祛风除湿(水肿处拔出水液)、通络止痛(急性扭伤劳损“疗效颇佳”)、泻热消肿(热毒疮肿)。他的总括是“既可祛邪，也可补虚，既可温经，又可泻热”，也就是刺络不限于实热证。
takeaways.en: He lists six actions for pricking-cupping. Activating blood and freeing the collaterals is "the most important and most direct"; the others are removing stasis to generate the new, warming channels and dispersing cold, dispelling wind and damp (fluid is drawn from oedematous sites), freeing collaterals to stop pain (acute sprain and strain "quite effective"), and clearing heat and reducing swelling (toxic-heat sores). His summary is "it can both expel evil and tonify deficiency, both warm channels and drain heat": bloodletting is not confined to excess-heat patterns.

takeaways.zh: 适应证与道理逐病写出：哮喘“泻血祛邪应求其尽，可获立即止喘的良效”；带状疱疹“治疗的关键，在于消除神经根的炎症和水肿”，刺络拔罐“具有通经活络、活血化瘀、消肿去炎止痛之功效”；丹毒“在丹毒局部或加大椎刺络拔罐”；面瘫急性期在水肿处拔罐。在71条带刺络/三棱针/拔罐标签的处方中，49条把刺络与经穴刺法分成两组并用；在622例医案中108例提到刺络、拔罐、放血或三棱针，以脑卒中(21例，多为十宣放血)、面瘫(10例)、腰腿痛(8例)、带状疱疹(7例)居前。
takeaways.en: Indications come with a reason for each. Asthma: "drain blood to expel evil, and drain it all, for an immediate anti-asthmatic effect". Zoster: "the key is removing inflammation and oedema of the nerve root", and pricking-cupping "frees channels and collaterals, activates blood, reduces swelling, inflammation and pain". Erysipelas: prick-cup the lesion, or Dazhui as well. Facial palsy in the acute stage: cup the oedematous area. Of 71 prescription entries carrying a bloodletting, three-edged-needle or cupping tag, 49 put pricking and channel needling in two groups used together; of 622 cases, 108 mention pricking, cupping, bleeding or three-edged needle, mostly stroke (21, mostly Shixuan bleeding), facial palsy (10), waist-leg pain (8) and zoster (7).

takeaways.zh: 经筋刺法是他“汲取中医学经筋理论的精华”并结合临床创立，指导思想是“面部是手足三阳经筋散布结聚之处，凡面部与筋肉有关的疾患皆可从经筋论治”。面瘫的病机被写成“病本在经脉，病标在经筋”：寒则筋急、热则筋纵，“外感寒邪则筋急，外感热邪则筋纵”，因此“治愈关键在于经筋功能的恢复”，治则是“祛外邪、调气血、通经筋”。
takeaways.en: Jingjin needling was created by him "drawing on the essence of sinew-channel theory" together with clinical practice, guided by "the face is where the yang sinew channels of hand and foot spread and knot; every facial disorder involving muscle can be treated through the sinew channels". Facial palsy is put as "root in the channel, branch in the sinew": cold makes sinews tense, heat makes them slack, "cold tightens, heat slackens", so "the key to cure is recovery of sinew function", with the principle "expel exterior evil, regulate qi and blood, free the sinews".

takeaways.zh: 经筋刺法的操作有一个古法来源与一套具体参数。选穴上他把《灵枢》的“以痛为输”引申为“天应穴、阿是穴乃至压痛点、反应点”；针法上“多采取排刺及一针多向等透刺”，综合分刺、恢刺、合谷刺。主穴阳白四透(向上星、头维、攒竹、丝竹空)、太阳透地仓或颊车、地仓与颊车间阳明经筋排刺，每隔0.5寸1针，针尖与表皮成15度；睛明、下关用补法，余穴泻法，每穴手法0.5min，留针20min，每日1次，28日为1疗程。
takeaways.en: The needling has a classical root and a fixed set of parameters. For point choice he extends the Lingshu "take pain as the point" to "tender points, ashi points, points of reaction"; for technique he "mostly uses row needling and multi-direction through needling", combining the fen, hui and hegu needling of the Neijing. Main points: Yangbai four-way (toward Shangxing, Touwei, Cuanzhu, Sizhukong), Taiyang through to Dicang or Jiache, and row needling of the yangming sinew between Dicang and Jiache, one needle every 0.5 cun at 15 degrees to the skin; Jingming and Xiaguan tonified, the rest reduced, 0.5 min manipulation each, retained 20 min, once a day, 28 days a course.

takeaways.zh: 经筋刺法在面瘫处方里与刺络和经穴刺法三组同用：病久体虚加足三里(提插补法)，久病面肌抽动加健侧穴与刺络拔罐，风池等用于急性期“加强疏风通络之力”；刺络组每次两个部位，出血3~5ml，留罐不超过5分钟。12例面瘫医案里12例用透刺、排刺或围刺，10例提到经筋，10例提到刺络拔罐。术语在处方里被延用：7条处方设“经筋刺法”组，除面瘫2条外，吞咽困难用于颊肌、口轮匝肌排刺围刺，神经性皮炎、牛皮癣、痒疹用“毫针围刺”皮损。
takeaways.en: In the facial-palsy entries jingjin needling is used together with pricking-cupping and channel needling as three groups. Long illness with weakness adds Zusanli (lifting-thrusting tonification); long illness with facial twitching adds the healthy-side points and pricking-cupping; Fengchi and others serve the acute stage "to strengthen dispelling wind and freeing collaterals"; the pricking group takes two sites per session, 3-5 ml, retention under 5 minutes. Of 12 facial-palsy cases, all 12 use through, row or encircling needling, 10 mention the sinews and 10 mention pricking-cupping. The term is carried on in the entries: 7 prescriptions have a jingjin-needling group, besides 2 for facial palsy, dysphagia (row and encircling needles on cheek and orbicularis muscles) and neurodermatitis, psoriasis and prurigo (encircling skin lesions with filiform needles).

caveats.zh: 两书的“石氏针刺手法”是同一份材料(实用针灸学文字略有出入)。刺络拔罐的作用机理与现代医学解释(白细胞增多、微循环、神经根水肿等)是编者的说明，本指南只取其中医部分；出血量、留罐时间是从各病处方的【操作】栏数出的，各条格式不一。OCR问题：“以痛为输”的“输”字在原文缺失(引文里是空引号)；“睛明”“攒竹”“风府”等穴名在部分文字里印成“晴明”“竹”“风”；痤疮条“每罐出血2～3ml”印作“23ml”，本指南按2~3ml；“面肌痉挛”印作“面肌挛”，“疮痈”印作“疮痛”，引文照印。脑卒中处方的5~10ml指其中的刺络拔罐(肩痛等)，十宣另为每穴1~2ml。
caveats.en: The two books' "Shi's needling" chapters are one body of material (small wording differences in Practical). The mechanism explanations and modern interpretations (leukocyte increase, microcirculation, nerve-root oedema) are the compilers' account; this guide keeps only the Chinese-medicine part. In the stroke entry, 5-10 ml refers to its pricking-cupping and Shixuan is 1-2 ml each. Volumes and retention times are counted from the manipulation column of each entry, whose format varies. OCR: the character shu in "take pain as the point" is missing in the source (empty quotation marks in the quote); Jingming, Cuanzhu, Fengfu are printed in variant or truncated forms in places; the acne entry prints "2-3 ml" as "23 ml", read here as 2-3 ml; "facial spasm" and "sores" lose a character; quotes are as printed.
